LSO.note: The document names no authentication service.

facts.fact: Lesotho's NICR, in the Ministry of Home Affairs, says CRVS, identification and passport data are 'brought together under one roof' as an integrated system with a unique personal identification number issued upon birth registration.

systems.owner: Department of National Identity and Civil Registry

LSO.note: The document gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.

facts.fact: Lesotho's NICR says a unique personal identification number is issued upon birth registration.

LSO.note: The document says nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
The document says the system is integrated with NISSA but does not say the register is keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: Lesotho's action timeline lists implementing an Integrated National Digital Identity Ecosystem for 2026-2030 with MICSTI and UNICEF.
